## GovernedAuditRecordInput.approvalId property

Optional correlation id tying the records of one held call together.

A `confirm-first` call produces two records — `pending` when it is withheld, then `approved`<!-- -->/`rejected` when a human resolves it. Both carry the same `approvalId`<!-- -->, so overlapping calls with identical capability, requester, and argument summary can still be paired (and their wait time computed). Absent on records for calls that never raised an approval request.

**Signature:**

```typescript
readonly approvalId?: string;
```
